---
name: Bug report
about: Something behaves differently than the science page says
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**What you did**
The clicks/URL you used, e.g. "added orfDsup ×2 on Kepler-442 b, seed 7331".

**What happened**
The observed outcome (screenshot welcome).

**What you expected**
The expected outcome, and which line of `docs/guides/the-science.md` backs that expectation.

**Environment**
- OS + browser:
- Seed / world / organism (if a simulation issue):

**Checklist**
- [ ] The bug reproduces on the live demo, not only locally
- [ ] Not explained by the documented assumptions in the-science.md
